description: This Java class implements a log filter called MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It is designed to process log messages by passing only the message content downstream, filtering out metadata such as log priority and tags. The class is part of a logging framework used for on-screen or console logging where simplicity is preferred.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class for logging that passes only messages to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, passes only the message part downstream if mNext is not null.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
